prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production-ready Discord emote sprite atlas for the new Naruto bot, using the attached image solely as the character identity reference. Fully transparent background, no text, no captions, no numbers, no watermark. Consistent detailed cute anime chibi rendering, crisp clean outlines, readable expressive faces at small size, subtle white sticker edge. Preserve male Naruto: bright golden spiky hair, blue eyes, three whisker marks on EACH cheek, black band with metal Leaf headband, complete orange-and-black high-collar jacket. Warm, lively, mischievous but friendly everyday expressions. Every cell must contain only ONE Naruto and all hands/accessories fully within its cell. Read left to right, top to bottom: (1) cheerful waving hello; (2) broad warm smile; (3) thoughtful hand at chin; (4) shy blushing, looking aside; (5) puffed cheeks, arms crossed, mild pout; (6) gently offering a cup of tea, caring; (7) bright thumbs-up encouragement; (8) determined smile, hand to chest, loyalty to friends; (9) joyfully holding a small bowl of ramen with chopsticks; (10) sleepy yawn and drowsy eyes; (11) surprised wide eyes with hands slightly lifted; (12) relaxed peaceful little smile with a few small autumn leaves. Keep proportions and coloring identical across all twelve. No weapons, battle effects, background scene, extra people, or text.
